destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.tagline: Old imperial capital of wooden streets and temple gardens
destinations.description: Kyoto was the seat of the emperor from 794 to 1868. Walk Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka early, before the shops on the slope to Kiyomizu-dera open. Near Nanzen-ji, order yudofu, tofu simmered in kelp broth.
destinations.bestMonths: March to May, October to November
destinations.airport: Osaka Kansai (KIX), 75 min by Haruka train

experiences.title: Fushimi Inari at dawn
experiences.line: Walk the torii tunnels up Mount Inari before the trains fill

experiences.title: Arashiyama bamboo grove
experiences.line: Go early, then cross Togetsukyō Bridge over the Katsura

experiences.title: Nishiki Market lunch
experiences.line: A covered food street; try tamagoyaki and Kyoto pickles

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.tagline: Cliff villages on the rim of a flooded caldera
destinations.description: The island is what remains of a volcano that blew apart in the Late Bronze Age. A cliff path of about 10 km runs along the caldera edge from Fira to Oia. Order fava, a yellow split-pea purée, with a glass of Assyrtiko.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Santorini (JTR), 15 min by road to Fira

experiences.title: Fira to Oia on foot
experiences.line: The caldera path, three to four hours along the cliff top

experiences.title: Akrotiri excavations
experiences.line: A Bronze Age town preserved under volcanic ash

experiences.title: Palea Kameni hot springs
experiences.line: Swim from the boat into warm, rust-coloured water

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.tagline: Rice terraces inland, reef breaks on the south coast
destinations.description: Ubud sits in the hills north of Denpasar, among rice terraces still watered by the subak canal system. The Bukit Peninsula in the south has the reef breaks at Uluwatu and Padang Padang. For lunch, find a warung serving babi guling, spit-roast pork.
destinations.bestMonths: April to October
destinations.airport: Bali Ngurah Rai (DPS), about 90 min by road to Ubud

experiences.title: Jatiluwih rice terraces
experiences.line: Trails through the UNESCO-listed subak rice fields

experiences.title: Uluwatu Temple at sunset
experiences.line: A clifftop temple, then the kecak dance at dusk

experiences.title: Mount Batur sunrise
experiences.line: A two-hour climb in the dark to the crater rim

destinations.name: Lago di Braies
destinations.tagline: A green lake under the cliffs of the Croda del Becco
destinations.description: The lake lies at 1,496 m in the Fanes-Sennes-Braies nature park in South Tyrol. A flat path of about 3.5 km loops the shore in roughly an hour. Wooden rowing boats leave from the boathouse in summer.
destinations.bestMonths: June to September
destinations.airport: Innsbruck (INN), about 2 h by car

experiences.title: Lakeshore loop
experiences.line: About an hour on a flat path around the water

experiences.title: Rowing from the boathouse
experiences.line: Wooden boats from the jetty, in summer only

experiences.title: Start of the Alta Via 1
experiences.line: Trail 1 climbs from the south shore to Rifugio Biella

destinations.name: Zermatt
destinations.tagline: A car-free village under the Matterhorn
destinations.description: Cars stop at Täsch, and a shuttle train covers the last few kilometres. The Gornergrat rack railway climbs to 3,089 m, facing the Matterhorn and the Gorner Glacier. In winter the ski area links over the border to Cervinia in Italy.
destinations.bestMonths: December to April, July to September
destinations.airport: Zurich (ZRH), about 3.5 h by train via Visp

experiences.title: Gornergrat railway
experiences.line: Rack railway from the village up to 3,089 m

experiences.title: Five Lakes Walk
experiences.line: Blauherd to Sunnegga, past the Matterhorn in Stellisee

experiences.title: Klein Matterhorn
experiences.line: Cable cars up to the glacier station at 3,883 m

destinations.name: Tulum
destinations.tagline: Maya ruins on a cliff above the Caribbean
destinations.description: The walled Maya site stands on a 12 m cliff above the beach. Inland, the limestone is full of cenotes, flooded sinkholes you can swim in. The Sian Ka'an biosphere reserve begins just south of town.
destinations.bestMonths: November to April
destinations.airport: Tulum (TQO), about 40 min by road

experiences.title: Gran Cenote
experiences.line: Clear water and caverns, a short ride up the Cobá road

experiences.title: Tulum ruins
experiences.line: The walled site, then the beach below El Castillo

experiences.title: Sian Ka'an by boat
experiences.line: Lagoons and mangrove channels in the reserve

destinations.name: Porto
destinations.tagline: Tiled houses stacked above the Douro
destinations.description: The Ribeira quarter climbs from the river in rows of tiled and painted houses. Walk the upper deck of the iron bridge to Vila Nova de Gaia, where the port wine lodges line the quay. Order a francesinha, a meat sandwich under melted cheese and beer sauce.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Porto (OPO), 30 min by metro (line E)

experiences.title: São Bento station
experiences.line: About 20,000 azulejo tiles in the entrance hall

experiences.title: Port lodge tasting
experiences.line: A cellar tour and a tawny tasting in Gaia

experiences.title: Six bridges cruise
experiences.line: A short river trip under the Douro bridges

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.tagline: A city on two continents, split by the Bosphorus
destinations.description: The old city sits on a peninsula between the Golden Horn and the Sea of Marmara. Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque face each other across Sultanahmet Square. Take the city ferry from Eminönü to Kadıköy on the Asian shore.
destinations.bestMonths: April to May, September to October
destinations.airport: Istanbul (IST), about 1 h by road to Sultanahmet

experiences.title: Ferry to Kadıköy
experiences.line: A 20-minute crossing from Europe to Asia

experiences.title: Grand Bazaar
experiences.line: About 60 covered streets, begun in the 1450s

experiences.title: Balık ekmek at Eminönü
experiences.line: Grilled mackerel in bread by the Galata Bridge

destinations.name: Marrakech
destinations.tagline: A red-walled medina at the foot of the High Atlas
destinations.description: The medina is ringed by about 19 km of rammed-earth walls. At dusk, Jemaa el-Fnaa fills with food stalls serving harira and grilled meat. On clear winter days the snow on the High Atlas shows from the rooftops.
destinations.bestMonths: March to May, October to November
destinations.airport: Marrakech Menara (RAK), 20 min by road to the medina

experiences.title: Jemaa el-Fnaa at dusk
experiences.line: Stalls set up as the light goes; start with harira

experiences.title: Bahia Palace
experiences.line: Courtyards of zellij tile under painted cedar ceilings

experiences.title: Walks from Imlil
experiences.line: Atlas valley paths below Toubkal, 90 min by road

destinations.name: Hội An
destinations.tagline: A river port of yellow shophouses and silk lanterns
destinations.description: Hội An traded with Japan, China and Europe from the 15th to the 19th century, and its old town is a UNESCO site. The Japanese Covered Bridge dates from the 1590s. Try cao lầu, thick noodles with pork and greens in very little broth.
destinations.bestMonths: February to April
destinations.airport: Da Nang (DAD), about 45 min by road

experiences.title: Thu Bồn by lantern boat
experiences.line: An evening boat with paper lanterns on the river

experiences.title: Cao lầu at a street stall
experiences.line: The noodle dish the town claims as its own

experiences.title: Ride to An Bàng beach
experiences.line: A flat 5 km bike ride through rice fields to the sea

destinations.name: Prague
destinations.tagline: A medieval centre on both banks of the Vltava
destinations.description: Prague Castle covers the hill above Malá Strana, with a Gothic cathedral at its core. The astronomical clock on Old Town Hall has been running since 1410. Cross the Vltava on the 14th-century stone bridge at first light.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September
destinations.airport: Prague (PRG), 40 min by Airport Express bus

experiences.title: Astronomical clock
experiences.line: The medieval clock on the Old Town Hall tower

experiences.title: Petřín hill
experiences.line: Orchard paths from Malá Strana to the lookout tower

experiences.title: Vyšehrad ramparts
experiences.line: Fortress walls above the river, south of the centre

destinations.name: Cartagena
destinations.tagline: A walled colonial port on the Caribbean
destinations.description: About 11 km of stone walls enclose the old city, built to defend the Spanish port. Getsemaní, just outside the walls, has the street food and the murals. Boats leave the Muelle de la Bodeguita for the Rosario Islands.
destinations.bestMonths: December to April
destinations.airport: Cartagena (CTG), 10 min by road

experiences.title: Sunset on the walls
experiences.line: Walk the ramparts above the Caribbean at dusk

experiences.title: Castillo de San Felipe
experiences.line: The Spanish fortress on San Lázaro hill and its tunnels

experiences.title: Rosario Islands
experiences.line: Snorkel the coral reefs, about an hour by boat

destinations.name: Amalfi Coast
destinations.tagline: Cliff towns on the south side of the Sorrento peninsula
destinations.description: The SS163 road follows the cliffs for about 50 km from Vietri sul Mare to Positano. Above Amalfi, the villa gardens of Ravello look straight down the coast. Lemons for limoncello grow on terraces held up by dry-stone walls.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Naples (NAP), about 90 min by road to Positano

experiences.title: Path of the Gods
experiences.line: Agerola to Nocelle, high above the sea

experiences.title: Amalfi to Positano by ferry
experiences.line: The cliff towns seen from the water

experiences.title: Ravello gardens
experiences.line: Terraces at Villa Cimbrone, 350 m above the sea

destinations.name: Dubrovnik
destinations.tagline: A walled limestone city on the Adriatic
destinations.description: The city walls run almost 2 km around the old town, and you can walk the full circuit. Stradun, the main street, is paved with limestone worn smooth and pale. A cable car climbs Mount Srđ for the view back over the roofs.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Dubrovnik (DBV), 30 to 40 min by airport bus

experiences.title: City walls circuit
experiences.line: Towers and ramparts on a 2 km loop above the sea

experiences.title: Kayak to Lokrum
experiences.line: Paddle out to the island facing the old harbour

experiences.title: Srđ cable car
experiences.line: Up to 405 m for the view over the old town

destinations.name: Cape Town
destinations.tagline: A city at the foot of Table Mountain
destinations.description: The flat top of Table Mountain stands about 1,085 m above the city. The Cape Peninsula runs south to Cape Point, with penguins at Boulders Beach on the way. Constantia, inside the city limits, has wine farms that date from the 1680s.
destinations.bestMonths: November to March
destinations.airport: Cape Town (CPT), 25 min by road to the city centre

experiences.title: Platteklip Gorge
experiences.line: The direct route up the front of Table Mountain

experiences.title: Boulders Beach penguins
experiences.line: African penguins on granite coves near Simon's Town

experiences.line: Tastings on estates dating from the 1680s

destinations.name: Hạ Long Bay
destinations.tagline: Limestone towers rising from a green bay
destinations.description: Some 1,600 limestone islands and islets rise from the Gulf of Tonkin here. Overnight boats anchor among them, away from the harbour lights. Kayaks pass under the rock arch of Luồn Cave into an enclosed lagoon.
destinations.bestMonths: March to April, October to November
destinations.airport: Hanoi Nội Bài (HAN), about 2.5 h by road

experiences.title: A night on the bay
experiences.line: An overnight boat anchored among the karsts

experiences.line: Large chambers on Bồ Hòn island, up a stone stairway

destinations.name: Big Sur
destinations.tagline: Highway 1 between the Santa Lucia range and the Pacific
destinations.description: Big Sur is about 145 km of coast between Carmel and San Simeon, followed by Highway 1. Along most of it the Santa Lucia Mountains drop straight into the ocean. Fog often covers the coast on summer mornings, so spring and autumn tend to be clearer.
destinations.bestMonths: April to May, September to October
destinations.airport: Monterey (MRY), about 45 min by road

experiences.title: Bixby Creek Bridge
experiences.line: The 1932 concrete arch, seen from the north pullout

experiences.title: McWay Falls overlook
experiences.line: A waterfall onto the sand, at the end of a short trail

experiences.title: Point Lobos
experiences.line: The Cypress Grove trail above coves with sea otters

destinations.name: Zanzibar
destinations.tagline: Coral-stone streets and an Indian Ocean reef
destinations.description: Stone Town, a UNESCO site, is built of coral stone, and many houses keep their carved wooden doors. Cloves from the farms inland made the island rich in the 19th century. On the east coast the tide pulls back far enough to walk out toward the reef.
destinations.bestMonths: June to October
destinations.airport: Zanzibar (ZNZ), 15 min by road to Stone Town

experiences.title: Forodhani night market
experiences.line: Grilled seafood on the Stone Town waterfront

experiences.line: Clove and nutmeg trees on the farms outside town

experiences.title: Mnemba Atoll
experiences.line: Snorkel the reef by boat from Matemwe

destinations.name: Banff
destinations.tagline: Canada's first national park, in the Rockies
destinations.description: Banff became Canada's first national park in 1885. Lake Louise and Moraine Lake get their turquoise from glacial silt. The Icefields Parkway runs north from Lake Louise toward Jasper.
destinations.bestMonths: June to September, December to March
destinations.airport: Calgary (YYC), about 90 min by road

experiences.line: A 3.5 km climb from Lake Louise to a hut by a tarn

experiences.line: A hot pool on Sulphur Mountain at 1,585 m

destinations.name: Torres del Paine
destinations.tagline: Granite towers above glacial lakes in Patagonia
destinations.description: The three granite towers that name the park rise straight out of the Patagonian steppe. The W Trek takes four to five days, from the towers west to Grey Glacier. Guanacos graze close to the park roads.
destinations.bestMonths: November to March
destinations.airport: Puerto Natales (PNT), about 2 h by road

experiences.title: Mirador Base Las Torres
experiences.line: A long day hike to the lake under the three towers

experiences.title: Grey Glacier by boat

destinations.name: Hallstatt
destinations.tagline: A salt-mining village on the Hallstätter See
destinations.description: Salt has been mined in the mountain above the village for some 7,000 years. Space is so tight that the church bone house holds more than 600 painted skulls. The 5fingers platform on the Krippenstein hangs over a 400 m drop.
destinations.bestMonths: May to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Salzburg (SZG), about 1 h by road

experiences.title: Hallstatt salt mine
experiences.line: Ride the miners' wooden slides inside the mountain

destinations.name: Lofoten
destinations.tagline: Fishing villages under granite peaks in the Arctic
destinations.description: The islands lie north of the Arctic Circle, yet the Gulf Stream keeps the harbours free of ice. Red rorbu cabins stand on stilts over the water at Reine and Hamnøy. From late May to mid-July the sun does not set.
destinations.bestMonths: June to August, February to March
destinations.airport: Harstad/Narvik Evenes (EVE), about 3 h by road to Svolvær

experiences.line: An open beach on Flakstadøya for clear winter nights

destinations.name: Plitvice Lakes
destinations.tagline: Terraced lakes in the karst of central Croatia
destinations.description: Sixteen lakes step down a valley, held back by travertine barriers that are still growing. Wooden boardwalks cross the water between the falls. Veliki slap, the tallest waterfall, drops 78 m.
destinations.bestMonths: April to June, September to October
destinations.airport: Zagreb (ZAG), about 2 h by road

experiences.title: Lower Lakes boardwalk

destinations.name: Queenstown
destinations.tagline: A lake town facing the Remarkables
destinations.description: Queenstown sits on the shore of Lake Wakatipu, across the water from the Remarkables range. A gondola climbs from the town centre to a lookout over the lake. Milford Sound is a long day trip by road through Te Anau.
destinations.bestMonths: December to March, June to August
destinations.airport: Queenstown (ZQN), about 15 min by road
